title: 第十七章 生死搏杀血染衣第十八章 道骨微鸣气自生
content_zh:
剧痛如同无数烧红的钢针，狠狠扎进楚夜的四肢百骸，每一次微弱的呼吸都像是在吞咽碎玻璃。眼前阵阵发黑，意识在冰冷的黑暗边缘摇摇欲坠。他瘫软在粗糙的树根旁，身体像一摊被彻底打烂的破布，连动一根手指都成了奢望。视线模糊，只能勉强看到前方那片混乱血腥的战场。
那颗仅存的狼头，正发出撕心裂肺、混杂着无尽暴怒和一丝恐惧的咆哮！它的血盆大口，带着同归于尽的疯狂，狠狠噬向那只从阴影中探出的诡异枯爪！
那枯爪覆盖着灰黑色、细密如同蛇鳞般的鳞片，指甲弯曲尖锐，如同淬了毒的鬼爪！面对狼王凶悍的反扑，枯爪没有半分退缩，反而以一种更诡异、更迅捷的速度，五指猛地张开！指尖萦绕着一股肉眼可见的、粘稠如同活物的灰败死气！
嗤——！
狼王森白的獠牙狠狠咬在枯爪的手腕部位！然而，预想中血肉撕裂的声音并未响起！那覆盖着鳞片的枯爪皮肤，竟坚韧得不可思议！狼王的獠牙只是勉强刺穿了最表层的鳞片，留下几个浅浅的血洞，根本无法造成致命伤！
反倒是枯爪上萦绕的灰败死气，如同跗骨之蛆，顺着狼王的獠牙和口腔，疯狂地侵蚀而上！
“吼——！！！”狼王仅存的狼头猛地发出一声痛苦到极致的惨嚎！那灰败死气所过之处，它坚韧的皮毛瞬间变得灰败、枯萎、失去光泽！仿佛被瞬间抽干了生命力！巨大的痛苦让它猛地甩头，想要挣脱！
但那只枯爪，如同冰冷的铁钳，死死地反扣住了狼王咬住它手腕的上下颚！灰败死气如同毒蛇，更凶猛地涌入狼王的口腔、咽喉！
与此同时，枯爪的另一只手（或者说，从同一片扭曲的阴影中探出的另一只枯爪！）快如鬼魅般探出，五指成爪，指尖死气凝聚如刀，带着刺耳的破空声，狠狠抓向狼王那颗失去生机、还残留着微弱灵魂波动的狼头眉心！
“呜…嗷嗷…”狼王仅存的狼眼因为剧痛和死气的侵蚀而变得浑浊、疯狂！它庞大的身躯疯狂挣扎、扭动，利爪在地上刨出深坑！但枯爪的力量和那诡异的死气仿佛对它有着天然的克制，死死钳制着它！
噗嗤！
那只抓向死亡狼头眉心的枯爪，终于得手！五根尖锐如同匕首的指甲，瞬间刺破了坚韧的头骨！一股微弱、带着暴戾不甘气息的、近乎透明的灵魂残片，被那只枯爪硬生生从狼头眉心抽了出来！
那灵魂残片在枯爪掌心疯狂扭动、尖啸，却无法挣脱那灰败死气的束缚！
“桀桀…”一声极其轻微、如同砂纸摩擦玻璃、充满了贪婪和满足的怪笑，仿佛直接在楚夜的心底响起！那是来自阴影深处的低语！
枯爪猛地一攥！那缕狼王的灵魂残片瞬间被灰败死气包裹、侵蚀、压缩，最后化作一颗米粒大小、散发着微弱暴戾魂光的灰黑色珠子，被枯爪迅速收回那片荡漾的阴影之中！
做完这一切，两只枯爪毫不停留，如同毒蛇回洞，瞬间缩回了那片扭曲的空气，消失得无影无踪。那片阴影也迅速平复，仿佛从未出现过。只留下原地疯狂挣扎、却气息急剧衰败、眼神彻底涣散的独头狼王！
“呜…呜…”狼王庞大的身躯如同被抽掉了脊梁骨，轰然瘫倒在地。它仅存的狼头无力地耷拉着，皮毛大片灰败枯萎，口鼻中溢出带着死气的黑血，幽绿的狼眼彻底失去了光彩，只剩下生命流逝前的空洞。那诡异的灰败死气，正在疯狂吞噬它最后的生机！
狼群彻底炸了锅！头领两颗头颅一死一垂死，那诡异枯爪的出现和消失，彻底击溃了这些凶兽的神经！恐惧压倒了复仇的欲望，剩余的二十多头黑鬣狼发出惊恐的呜咽，夹着尾巴，如同潮水般仓皇退去，瞬间消失在黑暗的密林深处。
死寂再次笼罩这片血腥的林地。只剩下狼王濒死的微弱喘息，以及楚夜自己沉重艰难的呼吸声。
楚夜躺在冰冷的土地上，浑身浴血，身体如同被彻底拆散。后背的混沌道骨搏动微弱到了极致，传递出的温热气流也几乎感觉不到。刚才那最后一道混沌毫光的爆发和双头狼王的重击，几乎榨干了他最后一点生机。

他眼睁睁看着那诡异的枯爪攫取了狼王的灵魂残片，看着狼王在灰败死气中迅速衰亡。那冰冷、贪婪、邪恶的气息，与寒渊密室里感受到的窥探感同源！它果然一直跟着自己！它在收集灵魂？还是…在寻找什么特定的东西？
一股冰冷的寒意顺着脊椎爬上来。这鬼东西，比黑鬣狼王恐怖百倍！它现在退去，是目的达成？还是…在等待更好的时机？比如…等自己彻底咽气？
“不…不能死…绝不能死在这…”楚夜在心底嘶吼！求生的欲望如同风中残烛，却顽强地燃烧着！母亲绝望的脸庞，楚狂澜冰冷的“三日”期限，还有那阴影窥探者的存在…像烧红的烙铁，狠狠烫在他的意识深处！
他需要力量！需要恢复！需要立刻离开这个鬼地方！
视线艰难地转动，落在了不远处那头巨大的双头狼王尸体上。尤其是那颗被枯爪攫取过灵魂、眉心有个小孔的头颅旁边…那颗依旧完好、却随着狼王本体衰亡而逐渐失去光泽的独头！
引气境巅峰凶兽的内丹！那是它全身精华所在！蕴含着狂暴却庞大的生命能量！
那是他唯一的希望！也是唯一的毒药！以他现在油尽灯枯的身体，贸然吞噬这种级别的凶兽内丹，九成九会直接爆体而亡！但…不吞，他连爬起来的力气都没有，只能等死！等那阴影再次出现，或者等下一波循着血腥味而来的掠食者！
“妈的…拼了！”楚夜眼中闪过一丝疯狂的狠厉！他强忍着全身骨头散架般的剧痛，调动起混沌道骨最后一丝微弱的力量，艰难地、一寸寸地朝着狼王尸体的方向爬去！
每一次挪动，都带来钻心的剧痛，汗水混合着血水浸透了破烂的衣衫，在身下拖出一道暗红色的痕迹。短短几丈的距离，却如同跨越了生死天堑。
终于，他爬到了那颗巨大的狼头旁。浓烈的血腥味和狼王尸体散发的残余凶煞之气几乎让他窒息。他颤抖着伸出沾满血污和泥土的手，五指如钩，用尽最后的力气，狠狠插进狼王脖颈下方相对柔软的皮毛里！指甲崩裂，鲜血淋漓，但他不管不顾，如同最原始的野兽，疯狂地撕扯、挖掘！
皮肉被撕开，温热的狼血喷溅了他一脸。他终于在坚硬的骨骼和筋肉之间，触摸到了一颗拳头大小、依旧散发着温热、如同熔岩般滚烫跳动的内丹！
这颗内丹呈现一种狂暴的暗红色，表面布满了如同血管般的黑色纹路，散发着令人心悸的能量波动！比之前那头普通头狼的内丹强大了何止十倍！
楚夜没有丝毫犹豫！他一把将那颗滚烫的、沾满血污的内丹从狼王胸腔里掏了出来！灼热的温度几乎烫伤他的手掌！他眼中只剩下不顾一切的疯狂，张开嘴，如同野兽般，狠狠一口咬了上去！
牙齿崩裂的剧痛传来！这内丹坚硬无比！但楚夜不管不顾，用尽全身力气啃咬、撕扯！同时，不顾一切地运转起那残缺的《混沌引》基础篇！
content_en:
The severe pain was like countless red-hot steel needles, piercing Chu Ye's limbs and bones, and every weak breath was like swallowing broken glass. His eyes were turning black, and his consciousness was teetering on the edge of the cold darkness. He slumped beside the rough tree roots, his body like a pile of completely beaten rags, and even moving a finger became a luxury. His vision was blurry, and he could only barely see the chaotic and bloody battlefield ahead.
The only remaining wolf head was letting out a heart-rending roar, mixed with endless rage and a hint of fear! Its bloody mouth, with the same madness of death, fiercely bit into the strange withered claw that poked out from the shadow!
The withered claws were covered with gray-black, fine snake-like scales, and the nails were curved and sharp, like poisonous ghost claws! Facing the fierce counterattack of the Wolf King, Withered Claw did not flinch at all, but instead opened its fingers at a weirder and faster speed! There is a visible, viscous, lifeless aura lingering on his fingertips!
laugh--!
Wolf King Senbai's fangs bit hard on Withered Claw's wrist! However, the expected sound of flesh and blood being torn apart did not sound! The skin of the withered claws covered with scales is incredibly tough! The wolf king's fangs barely penetrated the outermost scales, leaving a few shallow blood holes, unable to cause fatal injuries at all!
On the contrary, the lifeless energy lingering on the withered claws was like maggots on the tarsus, eroding crazily up the Wolf King's fangs and mouth!
"Roar——!!!" The remaining wolf head of the Wolf King suddenly let out a howl of extreme pain! Wherever the gray and dead air passes, its tough fur instantly becomes gray, withered, and loses its luster! It was as if the life force had been drained out in an instant! The huge pain made it shake its head violently, trying to break free!
But that withered claw, like a cold iron pincer, tightly locked the wolf king's upper and lower jaws on its wrist! The aura of despair and death was like a poisonous snake, pouring into the Wolf King's mouth and throat even more fiercely!
At the same time, Withered Claw's other hand (or rather, another Withered Claw protruding from the same twisted shadow!) quickly reached out like a ghost, its five fingers turned into claws, and the dead energy at the fingertips condensed like a knife. With a harsh sound of breaking through the air, it fiercely grabbed the wolf king's lifeless wolf head and eyebrows that still had weak soul fluctuations!
"Aww...aow..." The remaining wolf eyes of the Wolf King became cloudy and crazy due to the severe pain and death energy erosion! Its huge body struggled and twisted wildly, and its claws dug deep holes in the ground! But the power of Withered Claw and the strange death energy seemed to have a natural restraint on it, clamping down on it!
Poof!
The withered claw that grabbed the death wolf's head and brow finally succeeded! Five nails as sharp as daggers instantly pierced the tough skull! A weak, almost transparent soul fragment with a violent and unwilling aura was forcefully pulled out from between the wolf's head and brow by that withered claw!
The soul fragment twisted and screamed crazily in the palm of Withered Claw, but could not break free from the shackles of the desolate death energy!
"Jie Jie..." An extremely slight sound, like sandpaper rubbing against glass, full of greed and satisfaction, seemed to resound directly from the bottom of Chu Ye's heart! That's a whisper from the depths of the shadows!
Withered Claw clenched violently! The fragment of the Wolf King's soul was instantly wrapped, eroded, and compressed by the aura of death, and finally turned into a gray-black bead the size of a grain of rice, exuding a faint violent soul light, and was quickly taken back into the rippling shadow by the withered claws!
After doing all this, the two withered claws did not stop, like a poisonous snake returning to its hole, and instantly retracted into the twisted air and disappeared without a trace. The shadow quickly subsided, as if it had never appeared. Only the lone wolf king was left who was struggling wildly on the spot, but his aura was rapidly declining and his eyes were completely distracted!
"Woo... Wu..." The Wolf King's huge body seemed to have had its backbone ripped out, and collapsed to the ground. Its only remaining wolf head drooped weakly, its fur was gray and withered, black blood with lifeless blood overflowed from its mouth and nose, and its dark green wolf eyesIt has completely lost its luster, leaving only the void before life passed away. That strange aura of despair and death is frantically devouring its last vitality!
The wolves completely exploded! The two heads of the leader were dead and dying, and the appearance and disappearance of the strange withered claws completely broke the nerves of these ferocious beasts! Fear overwhelmed the desire for revenge. The remaining twenty or so black hyenas let out frightened whimpers, tails between their legs, and retreated hastily like the tide, disappearing in the depths of the dark forest in an instant.
Deathly silence once again enveloped this bloody woodland. Only the faint gasps of the Wolf King's dying breath and Chu Ye's own heavy and labored breathing were left.
Chu Ye lay on the cold ground, covered in blood, and his body seemed to be completely torn apart. The pulse of the chaotic bones on the back was extremely weak, and the warm air flow from it was almost unfeelable. The last burst of chaotic light and the heavy blow from the two-headed wolf king had almost drained him of his last bit of vitality.
He watched helplessly as the strange withered claws snatched away fragments of the Wolf King's soul, and watched as the Wolf King rapidly withered away in despair and death. That cold, greedy, evil aura has the same origin as the sense of prying eyes felt in Han Yuan's secret room! As expected, it has been following me! Is it collecting souls? Or... looking for something specific?
An icy chill ran up my spine. This ghost is a hundred times more terrifying than the Black Hyena Wolf King! If it recedes now, is its purpose achieved? Or...waiting for a better time? For example... wait until you die completely?
"No...can't die...must not die here..." Chu Ye roared in his heart! The desire to survive is like a candle in the wind, but it burns tenaciously! His mother's desperate face, Chu Kuanglan's cold "three-day" deadline, and the existence of the shadow spy... were like a red-hot iron, burning deep in his consciousness!
He needs strength! Need to restore! We need to leave this hellish place immediately!
His eyes turned with difficulty and landed on the huge two-headed wolf king corpse not far away. Especially next to the head that had its soul snatched away by withered claws and had a small hole between its eyebrows...the single head that was still intact but gradually lost its luster as the Wolf King's body declined!
The inner elixir of a ferocious beast at the peak of the Qi-inducing realm! That is the essence of its whole body! Contains violent but huge life energy!
That's his only hope! It’s also the only poison! With his body now exhausted and dry, if he rashly swallowed this level of ferocious beast inner elixir, 90% of the time he would explode and die! But...if he didn't swallow it, he wouldn't even have the strength to get up, so he could only wait to die! Wait for the shadow to appear again, or wait for the next wave of predators to follow the smell of blood!
"Damn it... fight!" A trace of madness flashed in Chu Ye's eyes! He endured the severe pain that felt like the bones in his body were falling apart, mobilized the last weak strength of his Chaos Dao Bones, and crawled towards the Wolf King's body inch by inch with difficulty!
Every time he moved, he felt excruciating pain. Sweat mixed with blood soaked through his tattered clothes, leaving a dark red mark underneath his body. The distance of just a few feet was like crossing the chasm between life and death.
Finally, he climbed to the huge wolf head. The strong smell of blood and the residual evil aura emanating from the Wolf King's corpse almost made him suffocate. He stretched out his trembling hand covered with blood and soil, his fingers like hooks, and used his last strength to pierce the relatively soft fur under the Wolf King's neck! His nails were cracked and dripping with blood, but he ignored it, tearing and digging crazily like the most primitive beast!
The skin and flesh were torn open, and warm wolf blood sprayed all over his face. He finally touched a fist-sized inner elixir between the hard bones and muscles, which still exuded warmth and was as hot and beating as lava!
This inner elixir is a violent dark red color, its surface is covered with black veins like veins, and it exudes heart-stopping energy fluctuations! It is more than ten times more powerful than the inner elixir of the ordinary wolf before!
Chu Ye didn't hesitate at all! He willThe hot, blood-stained inner elixir was taken out from the Wolf King's chest! The scorching heat almost burned his palms! There was only desperate madness in his eyes. He opened his mouth and bit into it like a wild beast!
The severe pain of a broken tooth came! This inner elixir is extremely hard! But Chu Ye didn't care, biting and tearing with all his strength! At the same time, desperately run the incomplete basic chapter of "Chaos Induction"!
